verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI supports configuring MCP servers (~/.gemini/settings.json) to extend the agent with custom tools, which is the generic mechanism that could connect to Jira, Slack, Google Drive, etc., and evidence shows it used for media-gen MCP servers (Imagen/Veo/Lyria) — demonstrating the extensibility pattern works. However, there is no direct evidence of documented or community-verified connectors specifically for Jira, Slack, or Google Drive. Missing for 10: named first-party or community MCP servers for Jira/Slack/Drive, hands-on confirmation these integrations work in practice.
